title: Avoiding Worldly Temptations and Women's Allure
summary: Prophet ﷺ warned against love for the world and women's temptations.
translation: Narrated Abu Saeed Al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Indeed, the world is sweet and green, and Allah has appointed you as successors in it, to see how you act. So beware of the world and beware of women, for the first trial for the children of Israel was due to women.' The world is likened to something sweet and luscious, but like a fresh fruit that soon loses its freshness, the allure of the world is temporary. The Prophet ﷺ further warned of women's allure leading to spiritual downfall, as historically it has been a cause of ruin for nations. The example of Balaam bin Ba'ura, who was misled by his wife's influence, illustrates this. Hence, one should focus on everlasting virtue and love for Allah.
